message: 監禁は土蔵に
I looked at Nanaka's seat.
Today, Nanaka is absent. Apparently she's feeling unwell.
For Nanaka, the picture of good health, to be absent...

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's fine~ It's just lack of sleep~ Probably~」
Even though Melilot-san said Nanaka was already fine.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan will be back to her energetic self by Sunday~」
Nanaka told me not to ask until after the Holy Night Festival ends.
So I decided not to ask either.
Still, is that really okay?

name: Sacchin
message: 「Trust me~ Look, look, clear eyes~」
Is the reason I can't bring myself to fully trust her despite how clear they look because my own heart is tainted?

name: Eddie
message: 「Synn! I managed to score some yakisoba bread! A whole two of 'em!」

name: Synn
message: 「...Good for you.」

name: Eddie
message: 「I'll give you one!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eeeh!?」

name: Eddie
message: 「Don't hold back! Eat this and cheer up!」

name: Synn
message: 「Am I looking so down that even you can tell, Eddie?」

name: Eddie
message: 「Something about the way you put that rubs me the wrong way, but I think anyone could tell.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
I'm worried about Nanaka. I'm worried about Nanaka. I'm worried about Nanaka.

name: Synn
message: 「I've got it!」
I'll go visit her on the way home! Yes, I'll do that!

name: Eddie
message: 「W-What's got into you!?」
Even though I can't buy a muskmelon, and we don't have canned peaches at home either.
I'll bring some produce harvested from our home vegetable garden.

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama ain't eatin' it!? Then yours truly will gladly help himself!」

name: Eddie
message: 「That's a token of friendship. Aaaah, our friendship is getting eaten!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Where's Nanaka-han!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Misasagi-senpai, are you still half-asleep~? You're the one who slipped Nana-chan sleeping pills and put her to sleep, Senpai~」

name: Synn
message: 「Sleeping pills!? W-What is the meaning of this!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「She looked terribly unwell, so I merely slipped her a little dose.」

name: Synn
message: 「Unwell--is Nanaka okay?! And what do you mean you 'slipped her a dose'!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I just got word that she snuck out of the house, you see. It seems she hasn't returned to Yuugiri-an either.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehhhhh~!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Snuck out!?」

name: Eddie
message: 「In short, confinement.」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me you were holding Nanaka captive! Why!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Would you kindly refrain from making it sound so scandalous? She was staying over at my place, so I simply slipped her a dose while I was at it and let her sleep.」

name: Synn
message: 「She stayed at Misasagi-senpai's house?!」
W-What happened to you, Nanaka!?

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's a super huge mansion, you know~. Amazing that Nana-chan managed to sneak out~. If it were me, I'd get lost just trying to find the bathroom~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You actually did get lost, didn't you.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. When it comes to confinement, a storehouse and ropes really are the way to go~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mornin'!」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Nanaka!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「N-Nana-chan!? Are you okay~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If a certain someone hadn't drugged me, I'd have been full of energy since morning!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you really okay!?」
I placed my hand on Nanaka's forehead. Doesn't seem like she has a fever or anything.

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What're you doin'!?」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What's with you guys, looking like you've seen a ghost. You're making way too big a fuss! Besides, having you worry about me throws me off!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-what are you doing, Bubuzuke!? H-hey, hold on.」
Misasagi-senpai grabbed Nanaka's hand and headed out into the hallway.

name: Synn
message: 「...What's going on here.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Umm, well--. There's a lot going on--. Basically, they're super close--?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jeez, I told you it's fine.」

name: Synn
message: 「What is?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't worry, Synn-kun--. Misasagi-senpai is rich, so--she's not gonna shakedown Nana-chan or anything--」

name: Synn
message: 「I wasn't worried about that.」
